title: at least one item should have a parseable date_published

spec.name: JSON Feed
spec.normative_quote: date_published (optional, string) specifies the date in RFC 3339 format.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false: the spec treats date_published as optional and imposes no parseability requirement (JSON Feed 1.1 does not require date_published to be present or parseable on any item -- this is our own inference, not spec text). This id is a local data-quality convention -- without at least one parseable date, this validator's own freshness check (feed-json-stale) cannot run at all, which is worth a warn. Verified against a live fetch of https://www.jsonfeed.org/version/1.1/ on 2026-07-30; the first sentence was already an exact quote and is unchanged, the second sentence (non-spec commentary) has been moved out of normative_quote into this note.

applicability: A parsed feed.json document whose "items" array is non-empty.
expectation: At least one item's "date_published" parses as a valid date.

cases.name: the only item's date_published does not parse
a conformant document with a parseable date
